title: Listen Then Reason: Perception-Grounded Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are increasingly used for a broader range of audio reasoning tasks. These models typically incorporate audio representations into a large language model (LLM) backbone to enable multimodal reasoning. Recent test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) methods further improve LLM reasoning capability by leveraging unlabelled test data after pre-training. However, the importance of the perceptual capability of LALMs remains underexplored, particularly how much acoustic evidence is integrated and relied upon during reasoning, and how this contributes to final task performance. This gap limits the development of effective post-training methods like TTRL for audio reasoning. In this work, we first analyse how audio information is integrated and utilised during reasoning process. translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型正被越来越广泛地应用于各类音频推理任务。这些模型通常将音频表示融入大型语言模型骨干中，以实现多模态推理。近期的测试时强化学习方法通过在预训练后利用未标注的测试数据，进一步提升了语言模型的推理能力。然而，LALMs感知能力的重要性仍未得到充分探索，尤其是模型在推理过程中整合并依赖了多少声学证据，以及这种依赖如何影响最终任务表现。这一研究空白限制了诸如测试时强化学习等有效后训练方法在音频推理领域的发展。在本工作中，我们首先分析了音频信息在推理过程中是如何被整合和利用的。我们对逐层的感知依赖程度进行了量化，并表明更强的声学依赖与更高的准确率以及更大的p（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过量化音频信息在推理过程中的逐层感知依赖性，发现更强的声学依赖与更高的任务准确率相关，并据此提出了以感知为锚定的测试时强化学习方法，弥合了大型音频-语言模型后训练方法的研究空白。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies layer-wise perceptual reliance during reasoning in large audio-language models, revealing that stronger acoustic reliance correlates with higher accuracy, and proposes perception-grounded test-time reinforcement learning to bridge the gap in post-training methods for audio reasoning.
